title: Issue flow fix turn fails with "the task cannot make this transition"
body: Seen on coderos-4080 (`chat work --issues 10256,10257,10258 --parallel 3`, runner at 8bf9ee262a+): #10258 failed with `The fix turn could not start: the task cannot make this transition`. The fix turn tries a task state transition the task store (v2) rejects — likely starting a fix turn on a task whose previous turn is in a state (ended/stopped/failed) that doesn't allow it, or a race with the parallel runs. Find the transition from the task's record in ~/.openagents on coderos, make the fix turn's transition valid (or start a fresh turn), add a regression test. A rerun of #10258 is in progress.
